title: moondrop-ctrl preset
description: A named EQ. The `eq` object alone (as written by `eq export` or the app's Export) is also accepted wherever an EQ file is read. Values must also fit the target profile's band count, limits and filter codes.

id.description: IDs starting with original- are reserved for snapshots.

note.description: What the preset does and how it was made (listening test, measurement, AI suggestion...).

profiles.description: Profile IDs it is meant for; empty = any device it fits.

enabled.description: false bypasses the custom EQ. Files from 0.2 use "slot": 3 (on) / 2 (off) instead.

items.description: Natural units. Files from 0.2 use gain_tenths_db / q_thousandths instead of gain_db / q; both are read.

gain_db.description: Gain in dB, e.g. -4.5. Ignored by pass and notch filters.

filter_type.description: Only types the target profile has filter codes for.

color.description: Display color only; never sent to the device.
